name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi
benefit: ₹6,000 / year direct cash transfer in 3 quarterly installments of ₹2,000
description: Financial safety net for small and marginal landholding farmer families across India for purchasing agricultural inputs.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Gramin)
benefit: ₹1,20,000 to ₹1,30,000 direct subsidy to construct a durable pucca house
description: Housing assistance for rural homeless families or those living in kutcha, dilapidated housing.

name: Ayushman Bharat (PM-JAY)
nameHindi: आयुष्मान भारत - प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना
benefit: ₹5,00,000 per family per year cashless hospitalization coverage
description: World's largest universal health coverage scheme offering secondary and tertiary inpatient care at empanelled public and private hospitals.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme for SC/ST/OBC/EWS
benefit: 100% Tuition Fee Waiver + ₹1,200/month maintenance allowance for university education
description: Direct financial aid to economically disadvantaged students pursuing post-secondary education in government-recognized institutions.

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
benefit: Guaranteed lifetime monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 after age 60
required_documents: Savings Bank Account / Jan Dhan Account
description: Government-backed retirement scheme providing guaranteed old-age security for unorganized sector workers.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
benefit: 8.2% Compound Annual Interest + Complete Tax-Free Maturity Corpus for Education & Marriage
description: Special government savings scheme for girl children under 10 years to secure their higher education and marriage fund.

name: National Social Assistance Scheme (Old Age Pension - IGNOAPS)
nameHindi: इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय वृद्धावस्था पेंशन योजना
benefit: ₹1,000 to ₹2,500 monthly destitute pension directly into bank account
description: Direct social assistance pension for senior citizens living below the poverty line with no sustained family support.

name: PM Mudra Yojana (Shishu & Kishore Micro-Credits)
nameHindi: प्रधानमंत्री मुद्रा योजना (शिशु व किशोर ऋण)
benefit: Collateral-free micro business loans from ₹50,000 up to ₹5,00,000 at subsidized interest rates
description: Institutional financing for non-corporate, non-farm micro and small enterprises to purchase equipment or working capital.
